name: button
description: An action with a face: a hue, an emphasis, and a size, with every state taken from the element itself.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: Which hue's ladder the button uses.

attributes.name: data-emphasis
attributes.description: How loud: high is a solid fill, medium an outline, low text alone.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Scales the text and the padding together.

children.description: An optional icon, sized to the text.
On a label.button, the radio or checkbox that makes it a toggle: hidden from sight, still focusable, pressed while checked.

tokens.name: --yeti-button-padding
tokens.description: Inline padding as a multiple of the size's space step.

tokens.name: --yeti-button-padding-block
tokens.description: Block padding as a multiple of the size's space step.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Gap between the icon and the label.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-fast
tokens.description: How long a hover or press takes to settle.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary
tokens.description: The default variant's color, when data-variant is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-on-primary
tokens.description: Text on the default variant's color.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-md
tokens.description: Text size when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The space step when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-focus
tokens.description: The focus ring a label.button toggle draws for its hidden input.

keyboard.action: Activates a button element; Enter follows a link.
On a label.button toggle, Space checks its input; the arrow keys move the choice within a radio group.

a11y.notes: Put the class on a button, an a, a submit input, or a label wrapping a radio or checkbox, nothing else. Use button for actions and a for navigation. An icon-only button needs an aria-label. A toggle is a label wrapping a native radio or checkbox, which needs no script, or a button with aria-pressed, which needs your script to move it; a button that is waiting sets aria-busy="true" together with aria-disabled="true", and your handler ignores presses while it waits.
